投稿本文:
I was actually more nervous right after I left. Once I settled into the new normal and had some concept of how I’d build up some income, I felt a little better. 

But either way, I think the deception of the comfortable paycheck is that it’s easy to write off the existential dread as work stress, generalized anxiety, something that is not a reflection of spending your life doing something you deeply don’t care about. And then the truly terrifying part is waking up after 20 years and realizing you cannot abide one single step further towards the shit you don’t care about without losing your ever-loving mind, so it’s time to figure it out.
